Prepare step by step

  1. If food, shelter or safety is urgent, use 211 or the closest responsible local service first.
  2. Identify the program and official application route before sharing household or financial information.
  3. Write down shown by the original source eligibility, document and recertification questions; do not ask this site to decide eligibility.
  4. Confirm service hours, geography, inventory and appointment rules directly before traveling.

General resource navigation only—not an eligibility decision, application, benefits advice, case management or guarantee of assistance.

Before you contact or choose a service.

  • Confirm current requirements, hours, eligibility, credentials, service area, accessibility, availability and total cost directly.
  • Keep names, narratives, account details, medical identifiers, child information and document text off this public page.
  • Directory appearance, order and paid status are not rankings, referrals, endorsements or proof of fit.
  • You choose whether to copy, print or share this plan; Franklin Navigator does not send it.
